sehemu: Part I: Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and President of Zanzibar
jina: Election of the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar
maudhui: (1) The Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar shall be elected by the people in Tanzania Zanzibar in accordance with the Constitution of Zanzibar and the procedure prescribed by a law enacted by the House of Representatives of Zanzibar concerning elections generally or the election of the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar. (2) Subject to the other provisions of this Constitution, the office of the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar shall become vacant and an election shall be held to fill that vacancy whenever any of the following occurs: (a) after dissolution of the House of Representatives; (b) after the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar resigns without first dissolving the House of Representatives; (c) after the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar loses the qualifications for holding elective office; (d) after the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar is impeached by the House of Representatives in accordance with the Constitution of Zanzibar, 1984 and removed from office; (e) after it is established in accordance with the Constitution of Zanzibar, 1984 that the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar is unable to discharge his functions; or (f) upon the death of the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar.
